name: screenshot-archiver
description: Standalone macOS CLI and nightly launchd service to archive Desktop screenshots and screen recordings into Obsidian/iCloud date folders via verified rsync -aXN + checksum + xattr.

scripts.install-agent: bun run build && bash bin/build_runner_app.sh && mkdir -p logs && cp launchd/com.matthew.screenshot-archiver.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.matthew.screenshot-archiver.plist && (launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.matthew.screenshot-archiver 2>/dev/null || true) && launchctl enable gui/$(id -u)/com.matthew.screenshot-archiver && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.matthew.screenshot-archiver.plist
